scope: Plato tab header, styling, and interactions

findings.area: header - left side: gradient chip icon
findings.description: PlatoMark_Chip is present on the left side of the header. Computed background-image is 'linear-gradient(120deg, rgb(251, 215, 255) 10%, rgb(255, 222, 193) 90%)' — a pink-to-peach gradient. The chip contains an SVG icon (sparkle/AI icon, aria-hidden). The chip element class is PlatoMark_Styled-Chip / PlatoMark_Chip, sized 26x26px with border-radius 7px.

findings.area: header - left side: Plato text label
findings.description: A plain Plato text node appears immediately after the chip on the left side (PlatoTab_Styled-HeaderLeft container). Text is 'Plato'. Layout is flex row.

PlatoTab_KebabButton is present on the right side (PlatoTab_Styled-HeaderRight). Contains an SVG with three circles at y=5, y=12, y=19 — this is the standard more-vertical (vertical three-dot kebab) icon from Lucide. Positioned at x=1158-1184 (right edge of the 600px-wide panel). Header is flex with justify-content: space-between and align-items: center, confirming correct left/right placement.

Header (PlatoTab_Styled-Header) is display:flex, justify-content:space-between, align-items:center. Header spans x=600-1200 (600px wide). Left side at x=616-686, right side (kebab) at x=1158-1184. Correct spatial separation confirmed.

All three candidates show 'Plato needs a resume' state: icon, h2 heading 'Plato needs a resume', paragraph 'Plato reviews a candidate from their resume. Add one to this candidate to get started.' Consistent across all three candidates tested.

Switching between Alonso Parker (13501), Filomena Hilll (13500), and Antonio Stoltenberg (13499) via column 2 links correctly updates the Plato tab for each candidate. URL updates to the correct applicant ID. Header and body re-render with correct structure each time. No stale state observed.

PlatoTab_Body (PlatoTab_Styled-Body) has overflow-y:auto, establishing an independent scroll container inside the tab. The outer JobApplicationContainer_Content also has overflow:auto, but the Plato tab has its own nested scroll area. Current no-resume content does not overflow (scrollHeight=clientHeight=676px), but the scroll infrastructure is correctly in place.
Zero console errors, zero console warnings across the entire session (183 total messages, all informational). No JS exceptions, no failed network requests surfaced to console.

The PlatoTab_KebabButton has no aria-label and no title attribute. Screen readers will announce this as an unlabeled button. Not a functional bug, but an accessibility gap. The SVG inside is aria-hidden (inherits from Icon component). Suggest adding aria-label='More options' or similar.

findings.area: candidate switching - Plato tab not auto-active after switch
findings.description: When clicking a different candidate from column 2 while on the Plato tab, the URL routes to /ai for the new candidate, but the Plato nav link loses its [active] state until re-clicked. Functionally the Plato content still renders, but the nav item highlight resets. This may be a routing/active-state issue in the applicant nav tabs. Observed: switching to Filomena showed Plato content correctly but Plato nav link was not marked [active] until explicitly clicked.

summary.notes: Header bar renders correctly: gradient chip icon (linear-gradient pink-to-peach, 26x26px, 7px radius) + 'Plato' text label on the left; more-vertical kebab icon button on the right in a flex space-between layout. No-resume state is consistent across all 3 candidates. Candidate switching updates the tab correctly. Tab has an independent scroll container. Zero console errors. Two informational items: missing aria-label on kebab button, and Plato nav link loses active state on candidate switch (content still renders correctly).
